aesthetic: Helvetica Stillness — warm-white ground with ink-black type and a single muted clay accent, held in tension by asymmetric Swiss margins that widen as the deck progresses from provocation to structure
chromaticArc: Slides 1–8 sit on pure warm paper with ink type only; slides 9–10 and 25–26 introduce parchment-veil backgrounds as quiet chapter breaks; clay whisper appears solely in two pull-quote rule lines at slides 14 and 30; the remaining thirty-four slides hold to warm paper ground, so the deck reads as a single sheet of good stock interrupted by two breaths of tonal shift
gridStrategy: All titles anchor at column 6 with span 24–30; body text begins at column 6 with span 34–36; the right third of every slide remains empty; early slides pack content higher (row 8–10) to create density and disorientation, while later slides drop content to row 14–18 with more leading, enacting the arc from compression to clarity

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: No secondary font is used; all type is Helvetica Neue at regular weight throughout

accentStrategy: No decorative elements; the only accent marks are two thin horizontal rules in clay whisper on slides 14 and 30, each 1px tall spanning columns 6–12, used to quietly demarcate the lens-taxonomy pull quotes from surrounding body text
